# Parameter reference {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| results: "asis"
#| echo: false
source("../_common.R")
```

## Common parameters across functions

This table summarizes the most commonly used parameters:

| Parameter | Type | Description | Default |
|-----------|------|-------------|---------|
| `sample` | Seurat | Seurat object to plot | Required |
| `features` | character | Genes or metadata to plot | Required* |
| `group.by` | character | Grouping variable | "seurat_clusters" |
| `split.by` | character | Splitting variable | NULL |
| `colors.use` | vector | Custom colors | NULL |
| `colorblind` | logical | Use colorblind-safe palette | FALSE |
| `legend.position` | character | Legend placement | "right" |
| `plot.title` | character | Plot title | NULL |

*Required for some functions only
